mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Badger Prairie County Park under a New Moon. Looking ahead, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 61 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous vote by the Common Council. This long-range roadmap was shaped by extensive community input and will focus on diverse housing, local business growth, and sustainable infrastructure in the coming decades.

There is plenty to do in our community this week, starting with trivia at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow. Also, make sure to visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on October 14 at Hometown Junction Park.

Regarding the weekly police report, on October 3, officers located an individual involved in a stolen firearm investigation while he was operating a vehicle with expired registration, leading to an arrest and the recovery of the weapon.
Culver's of Verona has closed for the night, so be sure to stop by tomorrow when they reopen at 10:00 AM to enjoy the flavor of the day, which will be OREO Cookie Cheesecake.
